name: Rajasthan & the Golden Triangle
about: Oct–Mar is the comfortable classic touring season for the forts and palaces; the tiger reserve at Ranthambore closes entirely Jul–Sep for monsoon, and counterintuitively the brutally hot Apr–Jun window gives the best tiger sightings as vegetation thins.
overview: India's classic first-time circuit — the Taj Mahal, Mughal Delhi, and Rajasthan's pink-walled Jaipur — extended to Ranthambore, one of India's best places to see a wild tiger, and the desert palaces of Udaipur.
costOverview: Street food, chai, and rickshaws cost almost nothing across the whole circuit — the Taj Mahal's foreign-visitor entrance fee and a few luxury heritage hotels are the real splurges.

specialSeasons.text: Thinning vegetation as the dry season peaks makes this the best window for tiger sightings at Ranthambore, despite the brutal heat.
